verdict.rationale: Choosing a data region or residency is a fair question for a cloud platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents region selection or data-residency controls. The packed docs cover the CLI, IaC, RBAC, managed identities and cost management. The only region-adjacent item is a community outage comment naming Sweden Central, which says nothing about choosing where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
